name: Tuscan White Bean & Rosemary Bruschetta (GF)
instructions: Toast gluten-free bread slices. Warm cannellini beans with olive oil, minced garlic, and lemon juice; mash coarsely and spoon over toast.

name: Creamy Polenta with Sautéed Mushrooms & Spinach
instructions: Simmer yellow cornmeal in vegetable broth until creamy. Sauté sliced cremini mushrooms, garlic, and spinach in olive oil and spoon on top.

name: Italian Baked Eggs in Marinara (Uova in Purgatorio)
instructions: Simmer crushed tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, and fresh basil. Crack eggs into wells in the sauce, cover until whites set, and top with Parmesan.

name: Spinach & Ricotta-Style Zucchini Frittata
instructions: Sauté diced zucchini and spinach in olive oil. Whisk eggs with Parmesan cheese, pour over vegetables, and bake until golden.

name: Ribollita Tuscan Kale & White Bean Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrots, and garlic in olive oil. Add crushed tomatoes, cannellini beans, spinach, and vegetable broth; simmer 25 minutes.

name: Caprese Quinoa & Roasted Tomato Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa in vegetable broth. Toss with halved fresh tomatoes, fresh basil, olive oil, lemon juice, and nutritional yeast.

name: Classic Spaghetti Pomodoro with Basil
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente. Toss in a skillet with olive oil, garlic, simmered crushed tomatoes, fresh basil, and grated Parmesan.

name: Italian Chopped Chickpea & Mozzarella Salad
instructions: Combine cooked chickpeas, diced tomatoes, bell pepper, diced mozzarella, and fresh basil; dress with olive oil and lemon juice.

name: Chicken Cacciatore with Bell Peppers & Tomatoes
instructions: Brown chicken thighs in olive oil. Simmer with sliced onion, bell peppers, mushrooms, garlic, crushed tomatoes, and fresh basil until tender.

name: Lemon Herb Garlic Salmon with Roasted Zucchini
instructions: Roast salmon fillets and sliced zucchini drizzled with olive oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, and fresh basil at 400°F for 18 minutes.

name: Mushroom & Spinach Arborio Risotto
instructions: Toast arborio rice with onion and garlic in olive oil. Gradually ladle warm vegetable broth while stirring, then fold in sautéed mushrooms, spinach, and Parmesan.

name: Classic Beef Bolognese over Spaghetti
instructions: Brown ground beef with finely diced onion and carrots in olive oil. Simmer with crushed tomatoes and whole milk; serve over spaghetti.

name: Blueberry Maple Oat Bowl with Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Simmer rolled oats in oat milk until tender. Top with fresh blueberries, pure maple syrup, and toasted pumpkin seeds.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Breakfast Hash
instructions: Dice sweet potatoes and sauté in olive oil with onion and bell pepper until crisp-tender. Fold in black beans and chili powder.

name: Classic Buttermilk-Style Blueberry Pancakes
instructions: Whisk all-purpose flour, whole milk, egg, melted butter, and maple syrup; fold in blueberries and griddle until golden.

name: Bacon, Egg & Cheddar Sourdough Scramble
instructions: Crisp bacon in a skillet, scramble eggs in the pan, fold in shredded cheddar cheese, and serve alongside toasted sourdough bread.

name: Harvest Quinoa Salad with Apple & Pumpkin Seeds
instructions: Toss cooked quinoa with diced apple, baby spinach, pumpkin seeds, olive oil, and lemon juice.

name: Homestyle Chicken & Vegetable Skillet Soup
instructions: Simmer diced chicken breast, diced russet potatoes, carrots, and onion in chicken broth until tender.

name: Classic Grilled Cheddar & Tomato on Sourdough
instructions: Layer cheddar cheese and sliced fresh tomatoes between sourdough slices spread with butter; toast in a skillet until melted.

name: All-American Beef Burger on Sourdough Toast
instructions: Sear seasoned ground beef patties and top with cheddar cheese, sliced tomato, and onion on toasted sourdough.

name: Herb-Roasted Chicken Breast with Garlic Potatoes
instructions: Roast chicken breasts, cubed russet potatoes, and broccoli florets tossed in olive oil and minced garlic at 425°F for 30 minutes.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Apples & Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Sear pork tenderloin in olive oil, then roast alongside wedged apples and cubed sweet potatoes drizzled with maple syrup.

name: Skillet Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Mix ground beef, rolled oats, egg, onion, and crushed tomatoes; bake until cooked through and serve with buttered russet mashed potatoes.

name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Broccoli
instructions: Pan-sear chicken breast in butter, simmer heavy cream with garlic and Parmesan cheese, and toss with steamed broccoli.

name: Spiced Red Lentil & Spinach Breakfast Dal
instructions: Simmer red lentils with turmeric, cumin, ginger, and garlic in water until soft; wilt in fresh spinach and finish with lemon juice.

name: Masala Chickpea & Potato Breakfast Hash
instructions: Sauté diced russet potatoes and onion in olive oil with cumin, turmeric, and garam masala; fold in chickpeas and cilantro.

name: Cardamom Banana Oat Porridge with Almonds
instructions: Cook rolled oats in almond milk with sliced banana, honey, and slivered almonds.

name: Mumbai Masala Egg Bhurji Scramble
instructions: Sauté onion, tomato, ginger, and turmeric in butter; scramble in beaten eggs and top with fresh cilantro.

name: Chana Masala Spiced Chickpea Curry with Basmati
instructions: Simmer chickpeas in crushed tomatoes with onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, and garam masala; serve over steamed basmati rice with cilantro.

name: Aloo Gobi Cauliflower & Potato Curry
instructions: Braise cauliflower florets and cubed russet potatoes with onion, tomatoes, turmeric, cumin, and ginger in olive oil.

name: Saag Paneer Spinach & Indian Cheese Curry
instructions: Wilt spinach with onion, garlic, ginger, and garam masala; blend with heavy cream and simmer cubed paneer cheese until tender.

name: Coconut Cashew Vegetable Korma
instructions: Simmer carrots, cauliflower, and bell pepper in coconut milk, vegetable broth, garam masala, and ground cashews.

name: Coconut Turmeric Chicken Curry with Basmati Rice
instructions: Simmer diced chicken thighs with onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, garam masala, crushed tomatoes, and coconut milk; serve with basmati rice.

name: Dal Tadka Spiced Red Lentils over Basmati
instructions: Boil red lentils with turmeric until creamy, then top with olive oil tempered with garlic, cumin, onion, and fresh tomatoes.

name: Classic Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken breast in Greek yogurt and garam masala, sear, and simmer in a spiced tomato and heavy cream sauce with basmati rice.

name: Goan Coconut Shrimp Curry
instructions: Simmer peeled shrimp in coconut milk, crushed tomatoes, ginger, garlic, turmeric, and lime juice; serve over basmati rice.

name: Savory Chicken & Ginger Rice Congee (Jook)
instructions: Simmer white rice in chicken broth with shredded chicken breast and sliced fresh ginger until porridge-like; garnish with scallions.

name: Sweet Potato & Chia Warm Oat Congee
instructions: Simmer rolled oats and diced sweet potato in water until thick; stir in chia seeds and a touch of honey.

name: Cantonese Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry over Rice
instructions: Soft-scramble eggs in olive oil, then toss with wedged fresh tomatoes, scallions, and a splash of soy sauce over white rice.

name: Sesame Scallion Crispy Tofu Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Pan-sear cubed firm tofu until golden, glaze with soy sauce and sesame oil, and serve over white rice with scallions and sesame seeds.

name: Garlic Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry (Allergen-Free)
instructions: Stir-fry sliced chicken breast and broccoli florets with garlic, ginger, and coconut aminos; serve over steamed white rice.

name: Sichuan-Style Garlic Cabbage & Pork Rice Bowl
instructions: Stir-fry sliced pork tenderloin and shredded cabbage with garlic, ginger, chili powder, and coconut aminos over white rice.

name: Crispy Tofu & Bell Pepper Stir-Fry with Soy
instructions: Sear firm tofu cubes and bell peppers; toss in a glaze of soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil over white rice.

name: Chicken & Peanut Kung Pao Rice Noodles
instructions: Toss cooked rice noodles with stir-fried chicken breast, bell pepper, scallions, roasted peanuts, soy sauce, and sesame oil.

name: Ginger Scallion Pork Tenderloin with Rice Noodles
instructions: Stir-fry thin pork tenderloin strips, shredded carrots, and scallions with fresh ginger, garlic, and coconut aminos; toss with rice noodles.

name: Velvet Chicken & Mushroom Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry sliced chicken breast, cremini mushrooms, and spinach with garlic, ginger, chicken broth, and coconut aminos over white rice.

name: Beef & Broccoli in Savory Soy-Sesame Glaze
instructions: Sear beef strips with broccoli florets, garlic, and ginger; glaze with soy sauce, chicken broth, and sesame oil over white rice.

name: Honey Sesame Garlic Salmon with Bok Choy/Cabbage
instructions: Glaze pan-seared salmon fillets with soy sauce, honey, garlic, and sesame seeds; serve alongside sautéed cabbage and white rice.

name: Black Bean & Avocado Corn Tortilla Breakfast Tacos
instructions: Warm corn tortillas and fill with seasoned black beans, diced avocado, fresh tomato, cilantro, and lime juice.

name: Sweet Potato, Corn & Pinto Bean Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Sauté diced sweet potato, onion, and corn kernels in olive oil with cumin and chili powder; fold in pinto beans and cilantro.

name: Huevos Rancheros on Crispy Corn Tortillas
instructions: Simmer crushed tomatoes with garlic and cumin. Top crisp corn tortillas with pinto beans, fried eggs, ranchero sauce, and avocado.

name: Chilaquiles Rojos with Eggs & Cheddar
instructions: Simmer cut corn tortillas in spiced crushed tomato sauce, top with fried eggs, shredded cheddar cheese, and fresh cilantro.

name: Cilantro-Lime Chicken & Black Bean Burrito Bowl
instructions: Layer white rice tossed with lime juice and cilantro, grilled spiced chicken breast, black beans, corn kernels, and diced avocado.

name: Oaxacan Pinto Bean & Roasted Sweet Potato Tacos
instructions: Roast cubed sweet potatoes with chili powder and cumin; serve in warm corn tortillas with mashed pinto beans, avocado, and lime.

name: Sopa de Tortilla Chicken & Tomato Lime Soup
instructions: Simmer shredded chicken breast, crushed tomatoes, onion, garlic, and cumin in chicken broth; garnish with avocado, cilantro, and lime.

name: Chicken & Cheddar Flour Quesadillas with Salsa
instructions: Fill flour tortillas with shredded chicken breast, cheddar cheese, and bell pepper; griddle until crisp and serve with fresh diced tomatoes.

name: Chicken Fajitas with Peppers, Onions & Corn Tortillas
instructions: Sear sliced chicken breast, bell peppers, and onion with cumin, chili powder, and lime juice; serve in warm corn tortillas with avocado.

name: Carne Asada Beef & Pinto Bean Bowl
instructions: Sear seasoned beef with garlic, cumin, and lime juice; serve over white rice with pinto beans, fresh tomatoes, and cilantro.

name: Baja Grilled Shrimp Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Sear chili-cumin spiced shrimp and serve in corn tortillas topped with lime-dressed shredded cabbage, avocado, and cilantro.

name: Chicken Enchiladas Rojas with Melted Mozzarella
instructions: Roll shredded chicken breast in corn tortillas, smother with spiced crushed tomato sauce and mozzarella cheese, and bake until bubbling.
